description: This Java class 'RatingStatistics' provides methods to analyze book ratings within a book tracking application. It includes functionality to find the most liked and least liked books, as well as calculating the average rating of read books. The class interacts with Book objects, uses a predefined shelf service, and leverages Java streams and comparators for its operations.

classes.name: RatingStatistics
classes.description: A class that provides statistical analysis of book ratings, including finding the most liked, least liked, and average ratings among read books.

methods.name: findMostLikedBook
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the book with the highest rating among read books, or empty if none or only one read book exists.

methods.name: findLeastLikedBook
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the book with the lowest rating among read books, or empty if none or only one read book exists.

methods.name: calculateAverageRatingGiven
methods.description: Calculates and returns the average rating of all read books that have a rating, or empty if none or only one.

methods.name: findReadBooksWithRatings
methods.description: Private method that filters and returns the list of read books that have a rating.

methods.name: calculateTotalRating
methods.description: Private method that sums up the ratings of all rated read books.
